propositions: T5c security findings are currently evaluated against plan specifications rather than the current codebase and configuration, causing 46% of strong findings to misdirect as ungrounded advisories
T5c generates redundant undeclared-access-posture findings (one per surface) across 99+ reviews, with duplicate template shapes displacing other criteria in advisory-cap-limited reviews
Ungrounded T5c findings that cite neither repo artifacts nor quoted plan sentences must be demoted to minor severity rather than suppressed, while grounded findings retain full strength

T5c blocking must scope to only two HIGH-class findings (plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths; undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces) at severity >= major, demoting all other findings to at most minor
The routing entry must change from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.90 with no inert blocking_enabled key, and all three pinned blocking-set assertions must include T5c
